call_get_device.doc: Retrieve cached information for a specific MAC address.

call_get_devices.doc: Retrieve all currently cached devices without scanning.

call_info.doc: Get full adapter hardware and driver metadata.

call_reset.doc: Reset Bluetooth adapter discovery state and clear cache.

call_scan.doc: Scan for Bluetooth devices in the vicinity.

call_scan_summary.doc: Perform a scan and return high-level vicinity statistics.

get_device_count.doc: Number of devices currently cached from recent scans.

get_discovering.doc: Whether the adapter is actively discovering.

get_is_zexmte.doc: Whether the adapter is a ZEXMTE CSR8510 module.

get_powered.doc: RF power state of the Bluetooth controller (True=ON, False=OFF).

set_powered.doc: Set the RF power state (True=ON, False=OFF).

call_get_lat_long.doc: Get current (latitude, longitude) tuple, or None if no fix.

call_get_position.doc: Get full position dictionary (lat, lon, altitude, satellites, speed, fix status).

call_read_raw.doc: Read last N raw NMEA sentences from receiver buffer.

call_wait_for_fix.doc: Block until satellite fix is achieved or timeout expires.

get_altitude.doc: Altitude in meters above sea level.

get_connected.doc: True while the receiver is plugged in; False while it is being reopened.

get_fix_quality.doc: GPS fix quality indicator (0=No fix, 1=GPS fix, 2=DGPS fix).

get_has_fix.doc: True if receiver has valid 2D/3D satellite fix.

get_lat_long.doc: Current (latitude, longitude) tuple, or None if no fix.

get_latitude.doc: Current latitude in decimal degrees, or None if no fix.

get_longitude.doc: Current longitude in decimal degrees, or None if no fix.

get_port.doc: Serial port connected to the GPS receiver.

get_satellites.doc: Number of satellites currently tracked / in view.

call_read_samples.doc: Read normalized complex64 IQ from all five channels: a list of five arrays.

get_center_freq.doc: Center frequency in Hz (channel 0; every channel is tuned together).

get_gain.doc: Tuner gain in dB per channel.

set_gain.doc: One gain in dB (or "auto") for every channel.

call_command.doc:
Any other command (parameter set, SRPS, RFSE, ...): value is an int32,
raw bytes, or None for no payload. Returns the packets after RESP.

call_frame.doc: GNFD: the next frame's data packets for the requested flag bits, {header: bytes}.

call_get_ap.doc: Get full AccessPoint metadata dictionary for a target.

call_get_ap_details.doc: Extract deep hardware & WPS telemetry (manufacturer, model, TSF clock).

call_get_channel_distribution.doc: Channel distribution map showing AP density and signal by channel.

call_get_history.doc: Get buffered history of RSSI measurements over time.

call_get_rssi.doc: Get the RSSI value (in dBm) for a target SSID or BSSID.

call_get_rssi_burst.doc: Collect burst of RSSI measurements with linear-power averaging.

call_scan.doc: Scan nearby Wi-Fi APs. Returns list of access point dictionaries.

call_scan_summary.doc: High-level RF environment summary (AP counts, band stats, strongest AP).

get_auto_rescan.doc: Whether active rescan is automatically triggered on scan calls.

get_default_route_safe.doc: Verification that default Ethernet gateway routing is intact.

get_device_info.doc: Hardware vendor ID, product ID, driver, and model.

get_interface.doc: Wireless interface name used by this dongle.

get_is_available.doc: Whether the USB dongle interface is present and active.

get_last_scan_time.doc: UNIX timestamp of the most recent scan.

get_scan_count.doc: Total number of scans executed since device initialization.

set_auto_rescan.doc: Enable or disable automatic active rescanning.
